beats.text: The fighting grew fiercer each day. Indrajit struck again and again, appearing and vanishing in the sky.
Lakshmana fought him arrow for arrow, protecting his brother's army.
At last a mighty Shakti weapon was hurled at Lakshmana, blazing like lightning. Valmiki says Ravana threw it; many tellings say Indrajit.
Lakshmana fell, unconscious and barely breathing.
Rama held him and wept. 'I can find another wife. I cannot find another brother.'
The whole army fell silent. Without Lakshmana, Rama said, he would not fight on.
The physician Sushena checked his pulse. 'He is alive. There is one hope: the Sanjeevani herb, from a mountain in the Himalayas.'
'But it must reach him before sunrise.' Every eye turned to Hanuman.
